# Phosphor Icons Attribution

HUMHUM uses four regular-weight Phosphor icons for the shared role navigation:

- `sparkle`
- `books`
- `envelope-simple`
- `circuitry`

Project: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core

The Android vector resources preserve the official 256 x 256 path data used by
the approved HTML preview. The project is MIT licensed; the full license is in
`docs/third-party/licenses/PHOSPHOR-ICONS-LICENSE.txt`.
